lessons.title: Tippi, bindi, addak and dotted letters
Greetings: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ, ਜੀ and ਤੁਸੀਂ
Pronouns and ਹੋਣਾ: am, is, are
Adjectives that agree: ਚੰਗਾ, ਚੰਗੇ, ਚੰਗੀ
ਦਾ / ਦੇ / ਦੀ: my, your, and family
Postpositions and the oblique: ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ, ਮੁੰਡੇ ਨੂੰ
Requests and commands: ਬੈਠੋ, ਦੱਸੋ ਜੀ
ਸੀ, ਸਨ: was, were, and used to

decks.name: Vowel signs
decks.desc: The ten vowel letters (ਅ ਆ ਇ ਈ ਉ ਊ ਏ ਐ ਓ ਔ) and eight vowel signs on ਕ (ਕਾ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਕੁ ਕੂ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਕੌ); ੳ ੲ and ਕੋ in the lesson

decks.name: Letters 1: k and ch rows
decks.desc: ਸ ਹ, ਕ ਖ ਗ ਘ, ਚ ਛ ਜ ਝ, one letter per card, with aspiration and the tonal letters ਘ ਝ; ਙ ਞ in the lesson only

decks.name: Letters 2: ṭ, t and p rows, and the rest
decks.desc: ਟ ਠ ਡ ਢ ਣ against ਤ ਥ ਦ ਧ ਨ, ਪ ਫ ਬ ਭ ਮ, ਯ ਰ ਲ ਵ ੜ

decks.name: Tippi, bindi and addak
decks.desc: Words with tippi, bindi and addak, the subscript letters, and the dotted letters ਸ਼ ਖ਼ ਗ਼ ਜ਼ ਫ਼

decks.name: Tones
decks.desc: Words that show low and high tone, with their level-tone neighbours: ਘੋੜਾ, ਕੋੜਾ, ਘਰ, ਚਾਹ

decks.name: Greetings and courtesy
decks.desc: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ, ਨਮਸਤੇ, ਜੀ, thank you, sorry, goodbye, and ਤੁਸੀਂ and ਤੂੰ

decks.name: Family and people
decks.desc: Family members on both sides, respect with ਜੀ and the plural, friends and words for people

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: Name, where you are from and live, work, languages, and what you were

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Numbers to 100, ਸੌ and ਹਜ਼ਾਰ, rupees and dollars, and asking the price

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Chai, lassi, roti, sarson da saag, ordering at a dhaba and at home, spice and paying

decks.name: Time, days and routine
decks.desc: Clock time with ਸਵਾ, ਸਾਢੇ, ਪੌਣੇ, days of the week, a day in the habitual, and plans

decks.name: Home and daily things
decks.desc: Rooms and objects with their gender, plurals, and what you are doing right now

decks.name: Describing things
decks.desc: Adjectives that change and ones that do not, colours, and comparing

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: Postpositions for places, left and right, buses, autos and trains, asking the way

decks.name: Shopping and the market
decks.desc: I like, I need, I have, prices, a little bargaining, clothes and sizes

decks.name: Health and help
decks.desc: Feeling sick, the doctor and the chemist, polite requests, must and can

decks.name: Questions and connectors
decks.desc: Question words, ਕੀ questions, and ਅਤੇ / ਤੇ, ਪਰ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ, ਇਸ ਲਈ

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: False friends and calques, ਨੇ in the past, ਤੂੰ, ਕੱਲ੍ਹ, and the tone and doubling slips

decks.name: Compliments
decks.desc: Praise for food, work, skills, homes and effort, and the modest ways Punjabis answer it.

decks.name: Flirting
decks.desc: Words people flirt with, phrases built from them, asking someone out, and kind ways to say no. For people who already know each other: open flirting with strangers is unusual in Punjab.

decks.name: Top nouns
decks.desc: The most-used nouns, with their gender.

decks.name: Top verbs
decks.desc: The most-used verbs, with the ਮੈਂ form for a man and a woman.

decks.name: Top adjectives
decks.desc: The most-used describing words, and whether they change.

decks.name: Top adverbs
decks.desc: Time, place, manner and degree: now, here, slowly, quite.

decks.name: Top pronouns
decks.desc: I, you, my, this, someone, and the forms before a postposition.

decks.name: Top postpositions
decks.desc: Punjabi's prepositions come after the noun: ਵਿੱਚ, ਨੂੰ, ਤੋਂ, ਨਾਲ and the rest.

decks.name: Top conjunctions
decks.desc: Joining words: and, if, when, then, even if, so that.

decks.name: Top interjections
decks.desc: What people really exclaim: ਵਾਹ, ਹਾਏ, ਓਏ, ਬੱਲੇ ਬੱਲੇ.

decks.name: Top words
decks.desc: Little words, question words, numbers, ordinals, days and times.
